svg.title: An inverse requires a choice of branch
svg.desc: Equal-scale axes show the nonnegative branch of y=x squared in blue and its inverse y=square root of x in violet. They reflect across y=x. Dashed gray curves show the excluded negative-input parabola branch and its reflected negative-square-root branch. Points (2,4) and (4,2) correspond.
